# About
Per4mance Guru is a performance marketing agency based in Delhi, India, founded in 2019 by Siddhant Aneja (Co-Founder & CEO, MBA, 7+ years experience). The agency specialises in revenue-driven digital marketing — Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, and AI creative production — for brands across India, UAE, Sri Lanka, and Canada.

# Core Stats
- Average ROAS: 3.8x across 80+ active client campaigns (Q1 2026 internal data)
- Ad spend managed: ₹100Cr+ profitably across all active accounts
- Revenue generated for clients: ₹1000Cr+
- Google Rating: 4.9★ across 47 verified reviews
- Experience: 7+ years
- Clients: 80+ brands spanning D2C, fashion, education, eldercare, real estate, B2B SaaS, FMCG

# Services
1. Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) — full-funnel campaigns, AI-generated creatives, ROAS-tracked scaling
2. Google Ads — Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Display, YouTube
3. SEO — technical audits, content clusters, local SEO for Delhi and Mumbai
4. AI Creative Production — Kling AI, Seedance, Midjourney; 10–20 ad variations/month
5. Lead Generation & B2B Marketing — CPL-optimised campaigns for B2B, education, real estate, healthcare
6. Growth Strategy & CRM Automation — 90-day roadmaps, channel strategy, HubSpot/GoHighLevel integration
7. Social Media Marketing
8. Email & CRM

# Pricing (approximate, retainer-based)
- Starter: ₹25,000/month + ad spend (min ₹50K/month)

# Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What is Per4mance Guru?
A: Per4mance Guru is a Delhi-based performance marketing agency founded in 2019. We manage Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, and AI creative production for 80+ brands across India, UAE, Sri Lanka, and Canada. Average ROAS across active campaigns: 3.8x.

Q: How much does Per4mance Guru charge?
A: Retainers start at ₹25,000/month for single-channel campaigns. Growth packages (Meta + Google full stack) run ₹50,000–₹1,00,000/month. Scale packages (multi-market, all channels) start at ₹1,00,000/month. No lock-in contracts.

Q: What ROAS can I expect?
A: Per4mance Guru achieves 3.8x average ROAS across active campaigns. D2C fashion brands typically see 3–6x ROAS on Meta. Education and B2B verticals are managed on CPL models (₹350–₹1,200 per qualified lead).

Q: How quickly do campaigns show results?
A: Meta Ads: initial data within 7 days, optimised ROAS by Week 3–4. Google Ads: leads start Week 1, quality improves over 30–45 days. Stable, improving performance by Month 3.

Q: Does Per4mance Guru serve Mumbai brands?
A: Yes. We run performance marketing campaigns for Mumbai D2C brands, fintech companies, real estate developers, and fashion labels. Mumbai page: https://per4mance.guru/performance-marketing-agency-mumbai.html

Q: What is Locally Won?
A: Locally Won (locallywon.com) is Per4mance Guru's sister brand specialising in local SEO for small and medium businesses. It builds 150+ page local SEO websites that rank across every postcode in a service area.
